evidence.detail: side nav already applies {{#current}}current{{/current}} to top-level and submenu items
footer submenu links render with no current class: <a {{#is_external}}class='external'{{/is_external}} href='{{url}}'> — current state is never applied
Menu.__post_init__ calls set_current() which sets item.current for all items including submenu items, so data is available but footer template ignores it

Add a small CSS rule in shared_web/static/css/pd.css to visually distinguish the current item in the footer context (e.g., bold or underline). No logic changes required since `current` is already set on all MenuItem objects.
